content: Wɛy mbuur wanswà ukäl anà unkyeey akà amfum abye anà ikɔ̈b, ntɔn, kà kye anà ikɔ̈b anki ikɔ̈ɔ̈n afà akà Nzam anà kàkɔ̈ɔ̈n asà Nde.
Abun, mbuur afàmbäär ikɔ̈b, nde afàmbäär nswɛɛŋ kàkwen Nzam. Baar bàfàmbäär ya, bàsànaan ntaaŋàmbar udu a ba ŋakwo.
Apan, antɛɛn kà baar awem bɔɔmà anki akà baar bàfàkyer ubwaŋ, wɛɛ akà baar bàfàkyer ube. Nkye ngye akwen mukɔɔn awem ntɛɛn bɔɔmà? Kyer ubwaŋ, waa nde kasyäŋà.

Ntɔn, nde wà un'syääl a Nzam ntɔn mukasiinà mukyer ubwaŋ. Wɛɛ, isàkal naa ngye afàkyer ube, apan, man bɔɔmà! Ntɔn, kà bunàbun anki awà nde anà kɔm mupà ntaaŋàmbar: nde wà un'syääl a Nzam ntɔn muswaŋ nkyɛl ande akà mbuur un'be.
Kyakin, yubwaŋ mukal anà unkyeey, kà nà ntɔn bɔɔmà a nkyɛl mpɛl anki, wɛɛ sye, ntɔn an'kyän.
Kyakin sye làfàfur bɛ iter, ntɔn baar bàfàwal bya, ba bà uboo a isal a Nzam ntɔn mukwey kya ubwaŋàbwaŋ.

Làpɛ akà mbuur mbuur undiir awà ilɔɔmà mukun'pà: itɛr, akà mbuur awal itɛr, ibaa, akà mbuur awal ibaa, bɔɔmà, akà mbuur awal bɔɔmà, làbɔ̈ɔ̈n, akà mbuur awal làbɔ̈ɔ̈n, ibyääl, akà mbuur awal ibyääl.
Twon lan'kal anà nkul a mbuur, naa tɛy, nkul abɛ, yà mukwen amwɛy anà bumwɛy. Ntɔn mbuur afàkwen mbuur wumwɛy, nde kan'kwey un'kɔɔn.
Apan, nswɛɛŋ asànaa: « Twon an'tà inswem, twon an'dwa, twon an'yib, twon an'yɔm mpem », anà yumwɛy yanswà, yan'bilà unsà ndaa yi: « Ngye asàkwen un'tɔŋ angye asànaa ngye ŋakwo. »
Ukwen bàfàkyer anki akà ube mwɛy akà un'tɔŋ. Ukwen, yà mukwey un'kɔɔn wanswà.
Làkäl kà igyɛɛŋ ntɔn ngyeel a Klistɔ
Làkäl kà igyɛɛŋ muyöb naa bi ibà mpal nà: làwiyà u twaal abɛ. Ntɔn ŋàbawà, ngweel a mɔ̈ɔ̈ yà tsütsü apà bi, akwànaa utaaŋ kàsɛmà bi musà làkwikilà.
Mpib yàbü itaan, mwäänà wà tsütsü. Lalan, bi ipiy isal a làpib, bi ibwaar an'tà a pɛɛlà.
Wɛy bi iyikyà a swalaa, asànaa u mwäänà answà, ukɔɔn in'kyɔm aŋàsöönà anà ngyöör a man, ukɔɔn ndaa a nswɛn anà ipasàsɛ, ukɔɔn an'sye anà un'köl.
Wɛɛ làbwäär Mwol Yɛsu Klistɔ, twon lan'pà mɔ̈ɔ̈ abɛ unsà ndür ntɔn mupà un'sak akà ilään aya.
